In relations with public authorities

The Circosta Law Firm provides specialised services in administrative law, assisting individuals, companies and institutions in their relations with public authorities.

We represent clients in litigation before administrative courts, offering strong advocacy in cases involving:

  • concessions;
  • permits and authorisations;
  • public contracts;
  • urban planning;
  • regulatory compliance.

Public procurement and administrative liability

Our work also covers disputes linked to public procurement and administrative liability, ensuring that companies participating in tenders or managing public resources receive reliable legal support.

We provide both preventive advice and judicial defence, protecting rights at every stage of proceedings.

Foreign companies in Italy

Thanks to our international perspective, we also help foreign companies navigate the Italian administrative system, ensuring transparency and legal certainty in their activities.
